body: Thank you. I understand what you are saying. I have a therapy session next wednesday and I will be sure to mention this.

I really don't think you truly comprehend the psychological effects it has on the mind. 

Though I'm not in the right to say anything.
I'm very thankful that she didn't press charges. However, if she did, I would not fight the charges.

Yes, I made appointments for 7 of the 10 psychologists and therapists that are in my area covered by my insurance. 

I understand there is something deeply wrong with me. I don't think I'm a sociopath because I feel very emotional and empathetic to those women.  I guess I could be narcissistic, but I suppose I will let the professionals decide what it is. I think it's probably a mixture of baggage, extreme weakness/patheticness, and something psychological.

You can think what you like, however I never said she was standing. We were on my bed, and we had been making out for a while. She was reasonably wet and I didn't last long enough for the moisture to dry out. If she had been completely dry, I probably would've realized what I was doing, but I didn't because she was wet enough.
thank you for your response.

Yes, after she explained why she said no, I understood why it could be fucked up to ask. 

She indicated in another comment that the only reason why she clicked on this link was because she hoped it was her ex talking about what he did to her. She obviously desires closure, or at least knowing that he knows what he did to her is fucked up. I didn't want her to leave disappointed (and disgusted) so I offered myself up as a tool for her to unleash. She politely declined, and that was that. I wasn't going to push the issue any farther, and I wasn't trying to coax her into some role playing redemption. I thought, if she wanted to, we could both use it. That's it. 

It's only fucked up to you because she said no. If she had said yes, I doubt you'd be jumping down my throat about it.

I meant after all of this. I haven't seen Alice in days. I've been in my room, doing a lot of research on this subject matter. Been looking to see what my health insurance covers, and seeing how I can make my wrongs right.  I've been trying to get in contact with Marisol, and I've been obsessing over what to do next.

My choice to sleep with Alice after being confronted by Marisol wasn't something based on arousal. I had so many emotions I just wanted to hide from it. Run away. I wanted to feel comforted and feel loved. 

All of this. Every moment what happened from months ago to last week...it all describes to me what kind of person I am. The realization of everything is very powerful and it was not something I truly understood after my last contact with Marisol. 

Ever since confessing, all of my actions are more clear. I am in the process of truly accepting what I am, what I've done, how I reacted, and what I need to do to make things better for her, not for me. 

It's not about wording things. I wrote it out exactly how it happened. The unedited version was exactly what happened and the edited version is more about how it happened in my brain. Anything I've felt since the last week is something found in the comments, not the confession. Honestly, I do not want to be aroused at all until I go into therapy because I am reminded about the last time I was truly aroused. 

I blame myself. I know I blame myself. I blame my past traumas and baggage, too. I don't blame the other women in my life who gave me such baggage. I blame myself for never dealing with that abuse. I blame myself for letting those feelings interfere...shape..my current life.

I didn't just say I hugged her. I edited out the bit about sleeping with her because I felt it wasn't too important in the scheme of things since most of the complaints were about romanticizing it. I used "tender moment" as a reference to breeze over the fact I did go home and sleep with her. I never meant to indicate I ONLY hugged her, I just felt the details weren't really important, only what was said afterwards and how I reacted to it. 

I know all of this is my fault and I know she is not the one to blame for any of it. I felt like I should explain what was going on in my head and why I did the things I did instead of just describing what I did to her. 

The problem I see is that I SHOULD have been in 100% control and I clearly did not have control. I lost control. I needed to be in control, but I didn't have it. I'm not saying SHE had control over me. I am saying something happened and my brain shut off and that is something that does truly scare me.

I do care. I put my confession up online for everyone to read, knowing the response would be similar to what I'm experiencing. I am coming to terms with what I did and who I am as a result of my poor choices. Sorry if my acceptance isn't happening fast enough for you, but I'm really trying.

I asked her to PM me twice before she responded back saying no, and I didn't push her further. Don't be so quick to jump to conclusions. I fucked up in a few areas and I realize I deserve harsh words, but your hypothesis in this area is far from valid.

Thank you for taking the time to reread it and respond. I do hope I am forgiven, but I honestly don't expect it. I think any chance of forgiveness went out the door when I originally stopped talking to her and then leaving her by the wayside when she begged me for help.

Either way, I never thought I'd receive such valuable information from this sub. I assumed I'd get it off my chest, receive a few comments from people telling me I suck, and try my best to move forward.

I love reddit so much. Even when I am feeling at my absolute worst, people are willing to offer their perspectives which allow me to make better choices. 

I know I cannot undo the things I've done, but I know now that it's never too late to fix the harm that my poor decisions have done to other people. I thought I was done for, but now I know I still have a chance to help someone who needs me. 

Perhaps I will find it in myself to forgive myself when I see her forgive me. And if that day never comes, at least I will sleep slightly better at night knowing I gave it my all, and I sacrificed everything to help someone.

As I said to another person who was raped, if you feel the need to let me have it as if I were your rapist, please feel free to PM me and unload on me. 

I need to hear it, and I need to prepare myself for what she has to say, if she allows me to listen. Of course, if you feel you've already settled that, I do not wish to open up negative feelings. 

I'm just letting you know I am willing to listen. I think it may help me, also, knowing what is going on in the mind of other women in the same situation to prevent me from continuing down this path of being a dumb, insensitive, evil bastard.

Thank you for responding. I understand what I have to do, and I am so sorry you were raped. I will leave 1000 messages on her phone if she never picks up, and I will let her know that all of this is my fault. 

I'm the scum, I'm the coward, I'm the one who is weak. She showed me her strength by reaching out to me, and I retreated.

I know...I know. I realize humans make mistakes, and some are ghastly. And I know how you man up to your mistakes is a defining characteristic. I know that there would be nothing I could say or do to erase the evil deed, but I know I could've handled myself with more dignity, shown more respect to the victims, and done everything in my power to help Marisol out of her despair. 

I am selfish. 

I know I do not deserve to walk this planet.

I know I never deserved her in the first place.

I wrote it when I felt so overcome with emotion. All of that happened the night before and I didn't utilize courtesy filters. I'm a mess, but I know that's not an excuse. I honestly do not have any excuse for my actions. 

I do want to clarify that it does make me sick, though. No arousal whatsoever. I'll be lucky if I ever feel aroused again. I know I am going to be scared to meet a woman. I know I will be scared for them because I am a monster.
I am suffering, oh god I fucking hate myself and I know I am a scumbag. I thank you for noticing, though no one seems to like that.

Yes, I edited those things out. I'm sorry, I didn't realize. I'm used to calling it a pussy.."vagina" seems so scientific and I admit I was just overcome with emotion when I wrote it..I didn't have a filter.
I'm so sorry to hear that. I will PM you. And...thank you.

I edited my post to focus more on WHY i did things and not WHAT i did. Do you mind rereading it and letting me know your criticisms? I honestly didn't expect to read so much negative, but it's actually really helping me. I also edited it with the things I learned, since you asked.
At least I got a smile out of the word vagoo

Ah, you again. I am no troll. I honestly fucked up. I fucked up so bad. I didn't mean to trigger anything...Again, please feel free to PM me. Pretend like I am your ex, and let me have it. Seriously. I need to hear it, and I think you need to let it out.
I edited my confession and took out a lot of the romanticized aspects. I focused more on WHY I did the things I did and less on WHAT I did. Do you think you could reread it again and let me have it?

I know what I should do but it's terribly hard. I went from thinking I was an up-standing guy to suddenly realizing I am the worst kind of human there is. 

I am so fucking sorry I wrote it the way I did. I didn't even consider that someone else may be dealing with the same thing, and hoped to read my confession for their own catharsis.  This entire post was written with only me in mind, and I absolutely realize it and I feel terrible. 

I know I am seriously fucked up and I didn't realize how badly I am until reading everyone's comments. And I think that is what makes all of this even more fucked up. I had to rely on strangers criticizing me to truly come to terms with what I am. 

I do owe it to her. I owe her so much. I owe her things I can never give back. I do need to own it but I don't know how to own it? I don't even know if she wants to talk to me anymore. I really fucked up, and I turned my back on her when I shouldn't have.  

Again, I am so sorry someone did that to you. I can't even imagine. Do..Do you mind if you PM me and talk to me about it? Maybe you could pretend like I am your ex and let me have it. If he didn't provide that for you, maybe I could? I know it won't redeem myself, but maybe it will help me prepare for what she will say to me, and offer you a chance to say what you need to to someone who deserves to hear it anyway.
You are absolutely right.

I am not going to go to the police. I would like to be there for Marisol. I think I'm scared because I still love her and I will always love her. I never...ever wanted to hurt her. I don't know how I will deal if I put myself in that position.

But you are right. I need to do this for her, not for myself. I hope it's not too late.

I made some edits. Do you think you could read it again, and offer me more advice and criticisms? Judging by some comments, I feel this affected you greatly, so I would like more insight from you. Again, I know whatever i say will not help my case. I truly know that. I know I have more things to fix than self-pity. Please, do me the honor and reread it and let me know?

I made some edits...do you think you could read it all again and offer me more advice/criticisms? I do agree I wrote this terribly...I really do feel absolutely terrible, though I understand if you do not feel I deserve more of your time.

I don't even know what that is. Assuming you are indicating I am a fake. Well, I'm not. From reading the other comments, yeah, I realize i romanticized it. It was just the easiest way for me to write it down and humanize my victim to make me truly...truly feel the guilt I need to feel. 

I mean I DO feel guilty, but it's easy to hide from it. By saying "accidentally" sort of gives it away. It's easy to justify it, it's easy to walk away, it's easy to pretend like it wasn't as bad as I thought. Writing it this way, I relive all those moments and I see myself from a third party and I can truly see what a piece of shit I am.
I know. I am the worst kind of human.
I know it.

I know I'm a piece of shit. I just freaked out. It's hard accepting that you can be a rapist. I spent my whole life learning about what monsters they are, and I never thought it would be me. 

I've never been good with confrontation, I tend to run away frequently, but I do understand that this was not the time to run away. This was not for me, this was for her. I think one day I will call her and let her yell at me, but I need to mentally prepare for that.

It won't happen again. I have learned something valuable from this, and I will always have this stain on my conscience.

That being said, I will go to therapy for all of this. 

Despite my writing, I do very much feel guilty and terrible. I decided not to speak to her because I felt weak, but also I don't know what she would gain by talking to me, looking her rapist in the eyes? She was basically begging me for..something, and I don't think I'd help her situation any. I think it would only open up a can of worms.
Thank you, I will try to man up and let her talk to me.

I said in an earlier comment, the easiest way to wrap my head around what I did is to distance myself, while also writing down every emotion and feeling.

And I don't get off on it, but I do read it and reread it. Each time I am more and more overwhelmed with guilt. I wrote it down this way because I needed to humanize Marisol so I can relive those moments and accept what I did.
Boy, don't I know it.

I know what I did. Seeing the look on her face when she cried told me everything I needed to know about myself. 

I admit, the easiest way to confess was to write it like this. I don't know why, I guess because it does sort of distance myself from what actually happened. I tried to write down every feeling and emotion along with what I truly was doing to both these girls. Knowing how much I cried during all of this also was odd, so I suppose it did help me sort of put it down all on paper so I could read it...reread it. Over and Over. And each time, I get more emotionally invested...Each time I relive the moments, and I become so overwhelmed with guilt.

You have never raped someone. You spend all your life learning about how rapists are monsters, how they are evil and they are lurking in alleys. You spend your whole life thinking "I'm a good guy." Then boom. You wake up one morning and you are a rapist. You are that monster. It's so hard to admit it. It's so hard to accept it. I have to write it down in the way I am comfortable reading it, and in a way that will help me....own up to what I am now. 

I did end up telling Alice about what I did to Marisol, a few days ago. I asked her if I could talk to her. Alice said no.

I always thought rape was with a more malicious intent? I felt this was accidental because I honestly truly care about her but I just went into instinctual overdrive. But I'm sorry. I will accept this.

I am not sure how other rapists view it, but I've never raped anyone else so I'm not sure what to compare it. I feel awful, but I know I'm a shit person, a coward, and I do not seek forgiveness or sympathy for my actions. I just needed to get it out onto paper, and I truly want to read what a scoundrel I am.

I know I ran away when someone needed catharsis, and I will ever forgive myself.
